summary: Non-Python modules can be documented with an adjacent .py file holding the doc sections or an adjacent .yml file with the same structure in pure YAML.
questions: How do I document a module written in Go or Bash?
Can module documentation be a YAML file?

answer_card.title: Documenting non-Python modules
answer_card.answer_md:
Either:
1. A `.py` file with the documentation sections, or
2. A `.yml` file with the same structure in YAML (e.g. `DOCUMENTATION: ...` instead of `DOCUMENTATION = r''' ... '''`).
